codes.meaning: Credential use passed authority, handle, scope, lifecycle, and exportability checks.
Current Authority Grant does not permit the requested credential operation.
Credential handle does not resolve to a broker-managed credential record.
Credential handle exists but is not in an ACTIVE usable state.
Credential or delegated material is expired/not currently valid.
Requested scopes/resources exceed credential or Authority Grant scope.
Credential issuer/service binding does not match the requested target.
Requested use mode/locality violates credential exportability.
Caller principal or Execution Binding does not match the authorized request.
Credential use request does not match the authorized Task context.
A short-lived delegated credential could not be created within requested bounds.
Backing secure credential store is unavailable or failed closed.
External authentication/token exchange failed without establishing the requested authenticated capability.
Credential-use count/rate/budget is exhausted.
Task/attempt cancellation invalidated the credential operation.
Credential or backing identity has been revoked.
Credential export/use mode requires explicit current approval.
Prior approval no longer matches provider/destination/scope/Task facts.
Broker prevented raw secret material from crossing a prohibited boundary.
Broker cannot prove the outcome of an externally observable authentication/operation and must reconcile rather than blindly retry.
